{{- /* An API reference package's folded member pages (properties, methods, ...) by the symbol they belong to. The generator marks a member `folded` when its content belongs on its parent symbol's page (scripts/generate-reference.ts); a namespace's members are not folded, they are symbols with pages of their own. Call it as partialCached "api-members-by-parent.html" .CurrentSection .CurrentSection.Path. Returns a dict: parent slug (the members' parent_symbol) -> slice of member pages. */ -}} {{- $s := newScratch -}} {{- range .RegularPages -}} {{- if and .Params.folded .Params.parent_symbol -}} {{- $s.Add .Params.parent_symbol (slice .) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $s.Values -}}
